BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.PARTS.title: Parts
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.PARTS.rogue_6_scrap_: Seed
Cultivate at the Secret Trader to obtain a reward.
What is growing inside it?
Blood Mushroom
Appraisal +2 after each combat.
Feast here to your heart’s content, until you are the one served on the plate.
Fog Tumbleweed
Appraisal +1 each time you reveal a node.
Swept along in the mist, it drifts farther and farther from earth and roots.
Echo Corn
Appraisal +3 per operator recruited.
Every kernel of flattery is clear and plump.
Wave
Appraisal changes randomly after each move.
Nature makes change, and thought colors it, so living things can proudly claim their freedom.
Frost Crystal Tree
Appraisal +4 after a perfect battle. Breaks after an imperfect battle.
Before sunlight pierces its entrails, it shows off the delicacy of what has yet to melt.
Growing Moss
Gain 3 <Dried Moss Balls> when obtained. Appraisal +1 whenever you obtain a part.
It creeps over soil, trees, dreams, and growth.
Dried Moss Ball
A natural part with a low appraisal.
Then come rot, withering, despair, and death.
Board Vine
Appraisal +4 whenever you obtain a part.
It grasps its own kind and refuses to let go.
Homesick Fruit
Appraisal −2 after each move.
Blinded by praise, it starts the countdown to its own end.
Brilliant Truffle
A natural part with a high appraisal.
Had it never been dug up and tasted, it would never have deserved such an honor.
Cage Controller
Has a special use in Encounters.
A brief silence does not amount to real control.
Thin Burial Grass
Low appraisal. Trade for rarer natural parts at an Exchange.
They bloom in the poorest soil, then die to nourish those that come after.
Life and Death
Starts with a low appraisal. After each move, spend 1 Originium Ingot for appraisal +3.
We stand in line. Each time the bell tolls, one falls.
Blood Orange
Appraisal +2 when entering a non-combat node.
Cut me open and enjoy me. Death will make flowers of us.
Travel Fluff
Appraisal increases with distance moved.
Go somewhere far, far away, then become a bookmark in a long journey.
Love Grass
Appraisal +6 after each battle. Double the target life lost after battle.
He’ll come back alive. He didn’t come back alive…
Unfated Fruit
Appraisal +10 on entering either trader. Selling at a Rogue Trader refreshes stock for free.
It did not grow this way to fetch a good price.
Seed Pod
Gain 1 Seed when entering the next region.
May every child have the chance to grow up in peace.
Scrap Wheel
Once loaded, move to any node [color=#20b4a1]within 2 spaces in a straight line[/color] ({Total} use).
If it breaks down any further, there will be no telling what it is.
Scrap Prosthetic
Once loaded, move to any of the [color=#20b4a1]8 adjacent spaces[/color] ({Total} use).
War gave it to a survivor. It will carry them back to the battlefield.
Standard Engine
Once loaded, move to any of the [color=#20b4a1]8 adjacent spaces[/color] ({Total} uses).
Can you hear what is missing beneath the roar?
Heavy Spring
Load to move within [color=#20b4a1]12 surrounding spaces[/color] for no AP ({Total} use). Breaks on entering the next region.
The first step of extension, the last step of life.
Air Cushion Base
Once loaded, move to any of the [color=#20b4a1]12 surrounding spaces[/color] ({Total} uses).
A thick but fragile cushion can shut out every discomfort.
Prototype Exoskeleton
Once loaded, move to any node [color=#20b4a1]within 3 spaces in a straight line[/color] ({Total} uses).
The richest poison is called being out of your depth.
Xiao Bajie
Load and use for a free jump to a random [color=#20b4a1]non-combat node[/color] ({Total} use). Breaks in the next region.
Do not ask why it is here or where it is going. It is only here to play.
Disposable Jetpack
Once loaded, move to [color=#20b4a1]any node[/color] for no AP ({Total} use).
Those who reach for the sky never look back at the land they burned to ashes.
Mother’s Snowmelt
Load to reach any [color=#20b4a1]non-combat node[/color] and gain {Hope} Hope ({Total} use).
The last wish of a Beast Lord before she faded away.
Cannot’s Tentacle
Load to reach any [color=#20b4a1]trader[/color]. Gain 4 Ingots ({Total} uses).
Its irregular writhing mirrors the wild fluctuations of its price.
Structural Principle
Once loaded, move to [color=#20b4a1]any node[/color] ({Total} uses).
Before the power runs out, carry everything out of the wilderness.
“Simple Remote”
Once loaded, move to any of the [color=#20b4a1]8 adjacent spaces[/color] for no AP, then gain 3 AP ({Total} use).
Ironic that a device for controlling beasts should soon steer the explorers’ fate.
Emergency Ejection Seat
Once loaded, move to any [color=#20b4a1]path end[/color], [color=#20b4a1]side path[/color], or [color=#20b4a1]Boss[/color] node ({Total} use).
It is just a seat. Why bring it along? Wait, what do you mean it has fuel?
Force Feedback Steering Wheel
Once loaded, move to any node [color=#20b4a1]in the same row or column[/color] ({Total} uses).
Well made, and perfect for anyone who likes to charge straight through.
Horn
Once loaded, move to any combat node in the [color=#20b4a1]12 surrounding spaces[/color] ({Total} use).
Press it and the jungle will make way. It won’t? Then why are you still pressing it?
Cannot Express
Once loaded, move to any [color=#20b4a1]Encounter node[/color] and turn it into a [color=#20b4a1]Rogue Trader[/color] ({Total} use).
It was all so fast you have no idea how you ended up in front of him.
White Bird
Part travel to [color=#20b4a1]combat[/color] grants +{Speed} allied Attack Speed that fight and {VictoryRelics} random collectible on victory ({Activations} activation).
Before the Originium took hold, its wings blotted out the sky.
White Dog
Use a part to reach a [color=#20b4a1]non-combat node[/color] to gain {Relics} random collectible ({Activations} activation).
Before the Originium took hold, its roar shook the earth.
White Fish
Use a part to reach [color=#20b4a1]any node[/color] to gain {Shield} Shield ({Activations} activation).
Before the Originium took hold, its tail stirred the ocean.
Painted Liberi
Use a part to reach a [color=#20b4a1]combat node[/color]. Allies gain {Speed} Attack Speed for that battle.
Originium gave them imagination and spirit.
Painted Perro
Use a part to reach a [color=#20b4a1]Wish node[/color] to gain {Relics} random collectible.
Originium taught them to endure and wait.
Painted Aegir
Use a part to reach an [color=#20b4a1]Exchange node[/color] to gain {Relics} random collectibles.
Originium gave them silence and room to grow.
Lorentz’s Eye
Use a part to reach a [color=#20b4a1]Vantage node[/color] to reveal the entire map ({Activations} activation).
In the instant of observation, possibility becomes certainty.
White Cannot
Sell a natural part worth 50+ Ingots for {RareRelics} random rare collectibles ({Activations} activation).
Once a common equivalent came into use, cooperation and division of labor became possible. It is a cornerstone of civilization.
Painted Cannot
Use a part to reach a [color=#20b4a1]Rest node[/color] to gain 1 random processed part.
Stripped of its threat, Originium is just a universal equivalent. Why should people be any different?
